output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function does not have a balance check before transferring tokens, which can lead to an integer overflow attack. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious users to transfer an excessive amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds or even a complete loss of control over the contract.

The 'lend' function does not have a balance check before transferring tokens, which can lead to an integer overflow attack. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious users to lend an excessive amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds or even a complete loss of control over the contract.

The 'repayLoan' function does not have a balance check before transferring tokens, which can lead to an integer overflow attack. This vulnerability can be exploited by malicious users to repay an excessive amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds or even a complete loss of control over the contract.
